<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 262.09938, which in positive‑mode ESI is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈261.0921 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₁H₁₇O₇ (calculated exact mass = 261.0974 Da, Δ ≈ 5 ppm). No other common elements are indicated, so the molecular formula is C11H17O7.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H17O7</final_answer>
